identity.description: Salesforce Commerce Cloud (B2C Commerce), now also branded Agentforce Commerce per a Trailhead community snippet (not fetched). Docs at developer.salesforce.com/docs/commerce cover B2C Commerce, its Commerce APIs (SCAPI), and the B2C developer tooling.
identity.identity_notes: The assignment's docs URL is the B2C Commerce developer documentation hub; the fetched pages describe Account Manager, SCAPI, and B2C Commerce storefront tooling. Renamed to Agentforce Commerce in some search snippets, which I did not fetch.

auth.oauth_flows: Client credentials for automation/service-to-service; interactive sign-in is available for the CLI; JWT signed with a certificate is also supported. Shopper APIs use SLAS (OAuth 2.1) per search snippet, not fetched.
auth.scopes_notes: Scopes are listed in an Authorization Scopes Catalog; multiple scopes are space-separated (from search snippet, not fetched). Shopper MCP pilot needs an SLAS client with the sfcc.shopper-mcpagent scope.

access.production_restrictions: No public self-serve sandbox was found. Sources point to partner-program access or an employer's existing realm; I could not confirm eligibility terms from official pages.

read_ops: Sales, search, and promotion performance analysis
write_ops: Deploy cartridges and Managed Runtime storefronts
api.limitations: Legacy OCAPI is deprecated and being disabled. SCAPI Admin APIs do not support browser sign-in as of release 26.8. Shopper MCP pilot exposes only a subset of shopper tools. Webhooks and SDKs could not be verified.
